gen-mystery-quest-fs-technor: Mystery Quest leaves every curve gaping open, like a storybook from an attic. It brings old-fashioned, bookish charm, while Technor, a glowing sans in neon-tube lines, brings a cool geometric precision.
gen-gf-unica-one-fs-technor: Unica One has a very large lowercase eye, with visible daylight inside every curve and strokes of one thickness. Technor, the sans-serif beneath it, runs cooler and more geometric.
gen-gf-wallpoet-fs-technor: Wallpoet leaves a line of bare paper showing between its letters. Bold, commanding weight up top meets Technor, a sans that holds an unvarying line from word to word.
gen-gf-warnes-fs-technor: Technor is a cool, geometric sans-serif drawn like neon tube, with a wide channel into every bowl. Warnes goes the other way, with ink strokes that taper out before touching and stretched, spacious tracking.
gen-irish-grover-fs-technor: Fun and organic, Irish Grover stands tall in its lowercase, with open throats and strokes that lighten softly toward the ends. Technor's sans lines then glide along in one steady thickness, curve after curve.
gen-luckiest-guy-fs-technor: Technor reads cool and geometric, a sans with neon-tube lines. Luckiest Guy does the shouting, cheerful, with a high mean line and ink that looks poured, while Technor handles precise, glowing detail.
gen-megrim-fs-technor: Angular and futuristic, Megrim holds every stroke ending at a measured thickness. Technor, the sans-serif beneath, glows in one steady line, so the heading's sharp edges and the body's tube-like curves feel like one machine.
gen-almendra-display-satoshi: Literary and ornate, Almendra Display never lets a letter pinch shut. Satoshi, a sans-serif, does the plain talking, with a soaring x-height and strokes cut like thread stitched along a path.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-spinnaker: Tightly knit rows, confident and strong: that's Oswald's whole look. Spinnaker, a modern plain sans, keeps its counters connected to outside space, so the whole pairing feels strong yet open.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-ar-one-sans: AR One Sans reads contemporary and modern, its brush ends lifting away before each curve closes. Chubbo, drawn like a marker tip bent from a single wire, adds a casual, inviting warmth along its smooth curves.
